content: We evaluated how the ability of ELMo contextualised word embedding models to disambiguate word senses depends on the nature of the training data. In particular, we compared the models trained on raw tokenized corpora and those trained on the corpora with word tokens replaced by their normal forms (lemmas). The models we trained are publicly available via the NLPL word embeddings repository BIBREF3.
